gerente-de-agentes.titulo: The manager who doesn't master agents

inicio.lead: The agent arrives, and the question left hanging in the room isn't technical: "what happens to me?" In eight lessons, you set the example, decide what stays with people, hold the hard conversation honestly, train the people joining, write the culture of the team and of the agent, change how you evaluate, and handle agents coming in and going out. You close with the area's people plan.
inicio.capa_alt: At the end of the workday, the sales manager of a distributor, seated at the head of the team table, watches two colleagues leave; behind the glass, the warehouse.

cursos.sub: Suggested order: G0 → G2 → G3 → G4 → G1 → G5. G1 (people) can run in parallel with the others, and anyone in HR can start with it. The people plan from lesson 8 is block 4 of the final project, in G5.

itens.t: The agentic company and the manager of 2027
itens.l: What changed in management, what the consultancies say, Brazil, your career and your first process.

itens.t: Processes: a process is not sacred
itens.l: Take the process apart before automating it: eliminate, simplify, redesign and decide who does each step.
Role, delegation, constitution, authority limit, progressive trust, agent team and exception queue.
Choose a model for each case, take care of context and company knowledge, and measure cost per result.
What stays with people, the conversation about change, the junior who supervises agents and team training.
Owners, permissions and records; evaluation and indicators; a LOOP-R cycle with a return and the program's final project.

inicio.aulas_sub: In the order a manager leads a team that has received agents: set the example, split the work, talk about fear, train the people joining, write the culture, evaluate differently, and handle HR for people and agents. Lesson 8 pulls it all together in the people plan.

itens: Area managers, owners of small and midsize businesses, and operations or HR leaders whose team already works, or soon will, alongside AI agents.
People who don't code and don't want to: here the subject is leading people. Building an agent is a different course.
People who have already heard the question "will AI replace me?" on their team and want to answer without lying and without scaring anyone.

blocos.t: What you walk away able to do
itens: Use agents in your own work in front of the team, and agree on the data rule and the time to experiment.
Split up, task by task, what stays with the person, what goes to the agent, and what both do together.
Hold the conversation about the fear of replacement and design the first 30 days for someone joining.
Write the team's values and their version for the agent, evaluate by what the person decides and reviews, and handle agents coming in and going out.

blocos.t: The case that runs through the course
itens: Horizonte Distribuidora, a

You play Patrícia Lima, the sales manager. Her team (Juliana in customer service and the salespeople) received Hora, an agent that sells over WhatsApp. In November, Lucas joins, the first junior hire since Hora.

The lab shows what happens when no one leads the change: hidden AI tools, an automation that sends customer conversations outside the company with no contract. Every lesson has one practice at Horizonte and another with your own team.
